set.body:
Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 2, 10.2; extended workspace. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2TV709N56C1WP05CMVKCG; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7ANWFHMXQJJRJ996WBG2.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own bounded live feature capability exposure through the checked loader, selected source and inspector. Reuse FeatureEdition/FeatureRecord/sidecar validation and existing feature lowerings; do not redo already implemented feature science/publication. Outside M1/four-screen mandatory scope.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. The same supplied feature values/support/grain/coverage/missingness/reducer/provenance are visible in existing publication and linked live inspection.
2. Missing or malformed sidecars never become zero; selecting a mark resolves the same qualified source identity and exact evidence.
3. Existing feature tests and new live selection/table/permission witnesses pass; this slice need not wait for the broader portable-output parent gate.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Disable optional live feature track while retaining existing edition publication and truthful absence.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Features] Expose checked feature editions in the shared workspace
